name: Is a plumbing inspection different from a plumbing estimate for repairs?

mainEntity.name: Is a plumbing inspection different from a plumbing estimate for repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a plumbing inspection is distinct from a repair estimate. An inspection is a comprehensive evaluation of the current state of your plumbing system to identify issues, regardless of whether you know they exist. A repair estimate, on the other hand, is requested when a known problem requires a quote for specific repair work. While an inspection can lead to repair estimates, its primary purpose is diagnosis and assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A plumbing inspection is a comprehensive evaluation to find issues; a repair estimate is a quote for fixing a known problem.
